habitat: subtropical/tropical moist montane forest; dense forest vegetation
story: The Bornean Green Magpie (Cissa jefferyi) is an extraordinary bird that belongs to the Corvidae family. It is most commonly observed in subtropical/tropical moist montane forest; dense forest vegetation, where its behaviors contribute to the ecological dynamics of the area. Listed as Least Concern (LC) by the IUCN, this species' future depends on continued conservation action. The story of the Bornean Green Magpie is one of adaptation and resilience, offering valuable lessons for conservationists. This poster aims to bring the Bornean Green Magpie into focus, highlighting its beauty and the importance of its habitat.
